title: ImprovEvolve: Basin-Hopping Meets LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary computation, most notably AlphaEvolve, has been remarkably successful in discovering novel mathematical constructions by solving challenging optimization problems. The standard approach is to evolve a monolithic program that directly outputs a candidate solution. We present ImprovEvolve, an algorithmic alternative that drastically reduces cognitive load on the LLM. Instead of prompting the model for an end-to-end optimizer, we evolve a program with three specialized operators of initialization, local improvement, and perturbation.
